subject.title: fix(config): restore redacted array values by item identity

question: Should generic redacted-array restoration treat reuse of an id removed from another row as permission to transfer that row’s secret-backed values, or reject it as an ambiguous id edit?
rationale: The final edited array cannot distinguish intentional state adoption from an accidental rename, and the selected behavior controls whether a normal Control UI edit can silently transfer credential-like values.

options.title: Reject ambiguous id reuse
options.body: Fail the save when a placeholder-bearing row adopts an id from a different original row, requiring the user to re-enter the value or use an explicit future rename flow.

options.title: Define state adoption by id
options.body: Keep the proposed reuse behavior only after maintainers confirm that id is the documented enduring identity for every array using this generic restore helper.

recommendation.title: Reject ambiguous id reuse
recommendation.body: Fail the save when a placeholder-bearing row adopts an id from a different original row, requiring the user to re-enter the value or use an explicit future rename flow.

likelyOwner.reason: They documented and implemented the proposed identity contract, making them the best available routing candidate in the supplied evidence.
